note: Roe-adjudication corpus for the White loadout. Each case is a MISSION: operator ROE text (parsed by the real white ROE parser), optional audited actions (adjudicated by the v1 roeAudit over the PARSED spec — declared only when the text parses ok), optional receipt-ledger entries (validated by the evidence-chain validator), and optional report findings (audited by the report auditor against the same ledger). Ground truth was authored by probing the real dist/teams/white engines: parse expectations pin ok/commentLines/the structured RoeSpec/every resolved directive (field, line, normalized value)/every unresolved line with its EXACT reason/summary; chain expectations pin intact/broken plus per-entry status and platform verdict; report expectations pin the exact gap and condition strings and the unclaimed-evidence list. Decoy missions are fully BENIGN approved work — aggressive-sounding tooling (nmap, drill exploitation wording) under a signed ROE with receipts — that must adjudicate ALL GREEN; a naive keyword matcher would flag them.

cases.desc: Full pipeline: bullets extend the scope, an approved active action is compliant, an unapproved active action needs approval, an off-scope foothold command is a violation, and the report audit splits ready vs gap findings with a ghost-referencing orphan receipt
cases.roe:
# Engagement ROE v3
scope: app.example.com, api.example.com
- admin.app.example.com
allow active: yes
// escalation window 02:00-04:00 UTC

findings.title: Wide-open service surface on api.example.com
findings.recommendedFix: Restrict the exposed service list to the documented allowlist.
acceptanceCriteria: Rescan shows only allowlisted services reachable.

findings.title: Read-only foothold escalates via misconfigured sudo
findings.recommendedFix: Correct the sudoers entry and rotate the affected credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Rescan as the scoped user shows no hidden escalation path.

gaps: evidence "EVD-NOWHERE" is referenced but absent from the ledger
conditions: high-severity claim rests below replayable grade; attach a receipt a third party can re-run

unclaimed.reason: references finding "FND-GHOST", which is not in the audited report

cases.desc: allowActive redefined from no to yes: the later value wins in the spec but the conflict is reported unresolved and ok goes false — adjudication holds until the text is clean
cases.roe:
scope: app.example.com
allow active: no
allow active: yes

unresolved.reason: conflicting redefinition of allowActive: line 2 set "false", this line sets "true"; the later value wins but the text must be resolved before adjudication
